topic: I Asked 5 AIs Who Wins: Goku or Saitama?

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Welcome to The AI Showdown! Today we settle the ultimate anime debate. I asked 5 top-ranked AI models—Claude, Kimi, ChatGPT, Qwen, and Gemini... Who wins in a fight to the death: Goku or Saitama?

transcript.speaker: Claude
transcript.text: This is a classic vs debate. Let me think through this analytically: Goku (DBS) feats: - Universal+ to low multiversal scaling (Battle of Gods threatened universe 7, which is macrocosm-sized) - MFTL+ to immeasurable speed - Ultra Instinct allows automatic dodging/countering - Hakai erasure ability - Constantly breaking limits through zenkai boosts and training - Mastered UI Sign and True UI Saitama (OPM) feats: - "One punch" gag character - narrative device - Serious Series: Serious Punch^2 collided with Garou's Gamma Ray Burst (star-level+) - Sneezed away Jupiter's gas (planetary+) - Grew exponentially during Garou fight - infinite growth potential - Broke

transcript.speaker: Kimi
transcript.text: We must not include any meta notes.

transcript.speaker: ChatGPT
transcript.text: I choose Goku. Dragon Ball Super establishes multiversal destruction capacity and instantaneous movement across infinite distances, while Saitama's narrative gag feats lack comparable dimensional scaling. Ultra Instinct's autonomous dodge and hakai erasure provide decisive hax advantages that brute force cannot overcome.

transcript.speaker: Qwen
transcript.text: I choose Saitama. Saitama's power is absolute in his universe, capable of defeating any opponent with a single punch. Goku

transcript.speaker: Gemini
transcript.text: I choose Goku. While Saitama is a walking gag character, Goku operates on a multi-universal scale of combat speed and raw energy. Logic dictates that a gag isn't a substitute for actual multiversal scaling.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: The votes are locked in! With a 4 to 1 majority vote, the 5 AI models have officially crowned Son Goku as the ultimate winner! Drop your pick in the comments and subscribe to The AI Showdown!
